ic_name: MIPI CSI-2 (Camera Serial Interface 2, MIPI Alliance)

clock_and_reset_waveform.POR_release: After Power-On Reset, devices must release both SDA and SCL (drive HIGH-Z) before any transaction.

bit_transfer_waveform.rule: Data on SDA must be stable while SCL is HIGH (data valid window). SDA may change while SCL is LOW (change-of-data window).
bit_transfer_waveform.figure: Figure 4 — Bit transfer on the I2C-bus

start_stop_waveform.start_S: SDA HIGH→LOW transition while SCL HIGH
start_stop_waveform.stop_P: SDA LOW→HIGH transition while SCL HIGH
start_stop_waveform.repeated_start_Sr: Same as S; keeps bus busy without intervening P

data_transfer_waveform.byte_unit: 8 data bits + 1 ACK clock = 9 SCL pulses per byte
data_transfer_waveform.ack_position: On the 9th SCL pulse; receiver pulls SDA LOW
data_transfer_waveform.figure: Figure 6 — Data transfer on the I2C-bus

timing_parameters_high_speed_mode.drive: Open-drain with current-source pull-up; SDA push-pull on HIGH

clock_stretching_waveform: Slave holds SCL LOW after a byte to extend the byte period; master enters wait state.
arbitration_waveform: While SCL HIGH, each master compares SDA actual to SDA driven; master that drove HIGH while bus is LOW loses arbitration immediately.
synchronization_waveform: SCL = wired-AND of all masters' SCL outputs; final LOW period = longest LOW, final HIGH period = shortest HIGH.

hs_entry_waveform.step_1_stop: LP-11 on both Dp and Dn (idle Stop state).
hs_entry_waveform.step_2_request: LP-01 (Dp LOW, Dn HIGH) for T-LPX (~50 ns min).
hs_entry_waveform.step_3_bridge: LP-00 (both LOW) for T-LPX (~50 ns min).
hs_entry_waveform.step_4_prepare: HS driver switches on; drive HS-0 (differential zero) for T-HS-PREPARE (40+4UI .. 85+6UI ns).
hs_entry_waveform.step_5_zero: Continue HS-0 for T-HS-ZERO (≥ 105 + 6 × UI ns) — receiver locks HS clock-data alignment.
hs_entry_waveform.step_6_sync: Transmit 8-bit Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire = 10111000).
hs_entry_waveform.step_7_payload: Stream CSI-2 packet bytes at full HS rate; byte 0 → lane 0, byte 1 → lane 1, ...
hs_entry_waveform.step_8_trail: Hold last bit for T-HS-TRAIL (max(8UI, 60+4UI) ns).
hs_entry_waveform.step_9_exit: Disable HS driver; LP driver forces LP-11 (Stop). T-HS-EXIT ≥ 100 ns of LP-11 before next transaction.

escape_entry_waveform.step_2_request: LP-10 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX.
escape_entry_waveform.step_4_escape_pattern: Transmit escape pattern (ULPS / Trigger / Reset code) at LP rate (≤ 10 Mbps).

payload_byte_serialization.ecc_byte_order: Single ECC byte covers DI + WC[7:0] + WC[15:8].
payload_byte_serialization.crc_byte_order: CRC-16 footer: CRC[7:0] first, then CRC[15:8] (little-endian on the wire over bytes; but computed MSB-first over payload).
payload_byte_serialization.multilane_interleave: Lane Distribution byte-interleaves the packet stream round-robin across the active data lanes; Lane Merging reassembles on the Rx.
payload_byte_serialization.checksum_byte_order: CRC LS Byte first, then CRC MS Byte.
payload_byte_serialization.burst_delimiters: Each HS burst is delimited by SoT (Start of Transmission) and EoT (End of Transmission) sequences; lanes return to LP-11 stop between bursts.

data_signaling_waveforms.HS_0: differential 0 (CLK_P - CLK_N < 0, i.e. Dn HIGH, Dp LOW)
data_signaling_waveforms.HS_1: differential 1 (CLK_P - CLK_N > 0, i.e. Dp HIGH, Dn LOW)
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_11: Stop state — both Dp and Dn at 1.2 V (CMOS HIGH)
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_01: HS Request — Dp LOW, Dn HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_10: Escape Request — Dp HIGH, Dn LOW

general_timing_rule: All HS payload bit timings derive from UI = 1 / data-rate-per-lane = 1 / (2 × Clock-Lane Hz). DDR clock: both edges of Clock+/Clock- latch one Data-Lane bit. Detailed numeric T-LPX / T-HS-PREPARE / T-HS-ZERO / T-HS-TRAIL bounds inherit from D-PHY v0.90.00 specification, referenced as [4] in DSI §3.5.

powerup_waveform.step_5_rx_sm_active: Peripheral Rx SM active; T_INIT_SLAVE timer begins.
powerup_waveform.step_6_host_lp11_drive: Host drives LP-11 throughout T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY.
powerup_waveform.step_7_clock_active: Host Clock Lane LP-11 → HS-0 → DDR waveform begins.
powerup_waveform.step_8_data_active: Host Data Lanes LP-11 → HS at first burst.

video_mode_named_timing_parameters_from_.description: Bit rate total on all Lanes

Defining min = 0 allows max PHY speed
No upper limit as long as line time is met

escape_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_p.step_2_request: LP-10 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX.
escape_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_p.step_4_escape_pattern: Transmit Escape Entry command + payload (LPDT data, Trigger code, or Reset code) at LP rate.

data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_11: Stop state — Dp and Dn at 1.2 V CMOS HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_01: HS Request — Dp LOW, Dn HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_10: Escape Request / Mark-One — Dp HIGH, Dn LOW

timing_model: Source-synchronous: D-PHY forwards a DDR clock on the Clock Lane so each clock edge clocks a bit on the data lanes (C-PHY embeds the clock in symbol transitions).
